issue_records.title: ≔ (\coloneq) generates "invalid identifier" error
issue_records.body_excerpt:
≔ (i.e. \coloneq) parsing fails with JuliaSyntax.
```
julia> ≔ = 1
ERROR: ParseError:
# Error @ REPL[2]:1:1
≔ = 1
╙ ── invalid identifier
Stacktrace:
 [1] top-level scope
   @ none:1
```
≔ is accepted as identifier character in FLISP parser.
```
julia> ≔ = 1
1
```

This with Julia 1.10
```
julia> versioninfo()
Julia Version 1.10.0
Commit 3120989f39b (2023-12-25 18:01 UTC)
```

issue_records.title: Allow any of `≔ ⩴ ≕` as identifiers
issue_records.body_excerpt:
These assignment-precedence operators shouldn't be special syntax and should instead be usable as normal identifiers just like `~`.

Fix #405

traceability_evidence.commit_message:
Allow any of `≔ ⩴ ≕` as identifiers (#478)

These assignment-precedence operators shouldn't be special syntax and
should instead be usable as normal identifiers just like `~`.

Also add more test cases for the true syntactic operators.

Fixes #405
